title: GEMglClipPlane
description: specify a plane against which all geometry is clipped

messages.description: which clipping plane is being positioned
list of the 4 coefficients of the plane equation

arguments.description: coefficient a of the plane equation (ax + by + cz + d = 0)
coefficient b of the plane equation
coefficient c of the plane equation
coefficient d of the plane equation

body: [GEMglClipPlane] calls glClipPlane() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glClipPlane in the OpenGL reference.
